investigation_notes.Description: An unusual volume of SharePoint file downloads (840 files) was observed for user Linas.Pavilionis@globalcorp.ee, well above the 24-hour baseline of 4. The activity originated from 78.60.112.55 to 40.108.201.15 on endpoint VIL-MTN-WKS-02, targeting the SharePoint Online site https://globalcorp.sharepoint.com/sites/Inovacijos_ir_Finansai/. The combination of high volume and external destination to retrieve a wide set of documents could indicate data exfiltration or account compromise and warrants immediate investigation with business context and access controls.
